description: This file defines an abstract base class 'WebsocketService' for managing websocket connections with features like automatic reconnection, error handling, and message processing. It includes methods for connection verification, reconnection logic with exponential backoff, message sending with retries, and handling websocket events. The class is intended to be subclassed with specific websocket connection and message handling implementations.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An abstract base class providing websocket connection management with automatic reconnection, error handling, and message processing logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebsocketService with optional automatic reconnection on error.

methods.name: _verify_connection
methods.description: Verifies if the websocket connection is active and responsive by sending a ping.

methods.name: _reconnect_websocket
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect the websocket and verify the connection.

methods.name: _try_reconnect
methods.description: Retries reconnection with exponential backoff up to a maximum number of attempts.

methods.name: send_with_retry
methods.description: Sends a message over websocket, attempting to reconnect and retry if sending fails.

methods.name: _maybe_try_reconnect
methods.description: Decides whether to attempt reconnection based on error and current state.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler
methods.description: Continuously receives messages, handling errors and reconnections as needed.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Prepares the service for connection, resetting disconnect flags.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Prepares the service for disconnection, setting disconnect flags.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Abstract method to establish websocket connection (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Abstract method to close websocket connection (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Abstract method to handle receiving messages from websocket (to be implemented by subclasses).
